title: TransactionRequest
description: Request body for executing Cypher statements within a transaction.

statements.description: Array of Cypher statements to execute within the transaction

CypherStatement.description: A single Cypher statement with optional parameters and result format.

statement.description: The Cypher query string to execute

parameters.description: Named parameters for the Cypher query. Always use parameters instead of string concatenation to prevent Cypher injection.

resultDataContents.description: Requested result formats. Possible values include row and graph.

includeStats.description: Whether to include query execution statistics in the response
